ownership.quote: Mistral AI SAS ... is a French artificial intelligence (AI) company headquartered in Paris. Founded in 2023, it develops large language models (LLMs).

stage.quote: Mistral today announced that it has raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, the largest equity fundraising round ever completed by a European technology company.
stage.note: Series D (Samsung-led, Sept 2026) is the last priced equity round; a separate $830M facility raised March 2026 was debt for data-center build-out, not an equity round.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of reported equity rounds: ~$117M seed (Jun 2023), ~$428M (Dec 2023), $16M Microsoft (Feb 2024), ~$645M (Jun 2024), ~$2.3B Series C led by ASML (Sep 2025, €2B at €12B/$14B valuation), and €3B/~$3.3B Series D led by Samsung (Sep 2026, >€21B valuation); EUR→USD figures per Wikipedia/press, not company-stated in USD. Excludes the separate $830M debt facility.
total_funding_usd.quote: In June 2023 ... €105 million ($117 million) ... On 10 December 2023 ... €385 million ($428 million) ... In June 2024, Mistral AI secured a €600 million ($645 million) funding round ... In September 2025, Bloomberg announced that Mistral AI has secured a €2 billion investment valuing it at €12 billion ($14 billion).

last_round.quote: Samsung Electronics led the round, joined by co-leads Scaleup Europe Fund, managed by EQT, and existing investor PSG Equity.

revenue.basis: CEO Arthur Mensch statement, reported by press
revenue.quote: Co-founder and CEO Arthur Mensch put the company's annualized revenue run rate at over 400 million dollars, compared to just 20 million dollars in the previous year.

note: French sovereign-AI champion; product on this card ('Mistral Compute' / 'Mistral AI Cloud', dedicated GB200/GB300/B300 capacity) is a division of Mistral AI, not a separately-financed entity, so all funding/ownership figures are for the whole company. Company also disclosed a target of ~$1B ARR by end of 2026 (Le Monde) and a separate $830M debt facility (Mar 2026) for European data centers, distinct from the equity rounds above.
